verdict.rationale: Asaas documents an official hosted MCP server at https://docs.asaas.com/mcp, with Cursor mcp.json setup and a branch parameter. Its documented scope is limited to letting an assistant query the documentation and API reference; there is no evidence that agents can perform account operations (charges, payments, customers) through it. Missing for 10: MCP tools that act on the payments API or account data, authentication for operational MCP access, setup docs for clients beyond Cursor, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
